name: definition-table-subdivision-year-start-not-listed
description: Invalid definition (fiscalclock 0.3.0), rejected by the cross-block checks, which run only when the definition has no block-level error. 2024-01-01, the first day of a fiscal year between the first and last entry, is not listed; the quarters row then does not run. The dates are illustrative. The complete error list is asserted (code and path of each error, sorted by path, then code).

source.citation: spec/definition-v1.md, year and subdivision type table and Cross-block checks (fiscalclock 0.3.0, ADR-0022), and spec/api-v1.md error catalogue
